name: Lianjiang
assessment: Official Lianjiang Natural Resources Bureau custody is evidenced, but no public anonymous parcel viewer/API or safe ID-plus-polygon response was verified. No sample GeoJSON was retained and runtime remains held.
queryAndRequestOutcome: Separate English and Chinese first-party discovery queries found the official local government portal and current Natural Resources Bureau notices. The current Guangdong public map JavaScript was inspected and exposed only base-map tiles. The province documents cadastral visualization through an identity-authenticated service; its bounded anonymous route returned no response. Direct TLS retrieval of the Lianjiang host failed certificate hostname verification and was not bypassed.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: Base-map configuration only; no parcel layer or feature-query route observed.
